readings.moment: Lina came down into the kitchen (thirteen minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock)
Madame's piano began (two minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock)
The temple struck eleven, and Lina was still in the kitchen after it
Madame's piano stopped (eleven minutes past eleven by the kitchen clock)
The hall clock struck eleven while the kitchen clock showed thirteen minutes past eleven

durations: The kitchen clock is a quarter of an hour (15 minutes) fast
The piano played from 10:58 to 11:11 by the kitchen clock, about 13 minutes
whereabouts: Rosa was in the kitchen during the evening, where the toast was being prepared
Lina had been working in the atelier with the master before he sent her down
Lina came down into the kitchen at 10:47 by the kitchen clock
Lina stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven
Lina sat on the stool in the kitchen
Rosa and Lina sat in the kitchen and listened to Madame's piano
Madame was playing the piano in the salon
After the hall clock struck eleven, Rosa went up the back stairs to the atelier to fetch the master, at Madame's request
Rosa called to the master in the atelier and he did not answer
The master was on the floor under the long windows in the atelier
Rosa walked down from the atelier, not running
Rosa found Madame in the salon at the piano
Madame told Rosa to fetch Dr Vauthier, then said to fetch the police first
Rosa fetched both Dr Vauthier and the police
